messages:
Priya Nair: Hey all — my dock/monitor bundle arrived but the external monitor says ‘No Signal’ and my keyboard/mouse are flaky. Starting laptop is a MacBook Air M2. Who should I ping for a replacement or quick troubleshooting? (new hire setup)
Liz (IT): @Priya welcome! Sorry about that. Can you check two quick things: 1) Does the monitor show anything if you plug it directly into the laptop HDMI/USB-C? 2) On mac, click Apple menu > About This Mac > System Report > USB and see if the dock shows up. If you prefer I can book a remote screenshare.
Priya Nair: Tried the direct USB-C -> monitor cable and still no display. Dock LED is on but keyboard unresponsive. I don’t have the exact model number on me — it’s the one from the brown box with the yellow label.
Liz (IT): OK can you paste a quick screenshot of System Report > USB or run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType | grep -i dock -A4` in Terminal and paste output? If you’re not comfortable doing that, reply and I’ll spin up a screenshare.
Priya Nair: Pasting the Terminal output: `USB Root Hub: Vendor ID 0x1234 Product ID 0x5678
  Dock Adapter: Manufacturer: GenericDock Co.
  Configuration: 1` (no other hubs listed).
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: HDK-3821 for Priya Nair — Dock/monitor hardware issue. Status: Open. Assigned: Liz (IT). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HDK-3821
Liz (IT): Thanks — looks like the dock is enumerating but the video passthrough isn’t. Could be a faulty HDMI module or cable. @Tom (Warehouse) can we get a replacement dock sent to Priya (onboarding address) next-business-day? If we have a spare faster, we can swap and close the ticket.
Tom (Warehouse): Yep — we have a spare USB-C dock (part #RD-DK2). I’ll ship today via UPS 2nd Day. Tracking: https://www.ups.com/track?loc=en_US&tracknum=1Z999AA10123456784 — ETA Wed. I’ll update the ticket when it ships.
Sam (Hiring Manager): @Priya sorry for the extra fuss on week one. LMK if you need a temporary keyboard/mouse from my desk.
Priya Nair: Received the new dock today and swapped it in — monitor works, keyboard/mouse all recognized. Tested external monitor at 1440p and ethernet link is stable. Thanks @Liz and @Tom! :tada:
Liz (IT): Awesome — marking HDK-3821 resolved. Closing the ticket now. If anything flares up, reopen or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket HDK-3821 status changed to Resolved by Liz (IT) at 1829999004.
